newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mainly steady, gas oil off.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mainly steady, gas oil off.

text.p: NWE oil products were mainly steady on Tuesday but gas oil was slightly lower.
Gas oil prices retreated around $1 in sympathy with lower futures but trade was virtually at a standstill in the runup to the expiry of the November futures contract,
Naphtha was steady despite a pullback in crude, with traders awaiting Egypt's 1997 tender results. Gasoline consolidated after Monday's rally with recent arbitrage opportunities supporting prices.
Fuel oil was steady after an initial bump up on barges related to pricing manoeuvres.
